candidates: When iterating over an object but only the value (not the key) is needed, prefer `Object.values(obj)[0]` over destructuring `let [key, value] = Object.entries(obj)[0]`; discarding a destructured variable triggers `no-unused-vars` lint warnings unnecessarily.

When adding ESLint `overrides` in `.eslintrc.json` to suppress rules for test/spec files (e.g. the `*.spec.{ts,js}`, `cypress/**`, or `docs/**` globs), prefer setting rules to `"warn"` rather than `"off"` so that newly introduced violations still appear in PR diffs; only escalate to `"off"` when the accumulated warning count is large enough to obscure real errors.
